Pakistan mediating. Tactical note: first 5-day pause (Mar 23) was violated hours later by strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr.

  • Northern Border & Combat Activity: Hezbollah active daily. Ongoing pattern: Israeli/US airstrikes on Iran; Iranian/Hezbollah/Hamas missile counterstrikes on Israel. No new confirmed major strikes reported in the last 2 hours.

Situation Report — Day 27

Active strikes/alerts: US/Israeli airstrikes on Iran continue. Iranian, Hezbollah and Hamas missile/rocket strikes against Israel ongoing, northern border active daily.
  • Attacks & alerts: Ongoing exchanges of strikes. Multiple cross-border launches toward northern Israel reported this cycle. Previous short pauses were violated; risk of repeat violations high.
  • Pause / talks: Trump announced a 10-day pause on Iranian energy strikes (deadline Apr 6, 2026 20:00 ET), citing an "Iranian Government request." Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan mediating. Tactical note: first pause (Mar 23) was violated within hours by US/Israeli strikes.
  • Northern Border (Hezbollah/Lebanon): Daily Hezbollah activity persists. Local ceasefire/renewal reports contradictory; fighting continues in places.
  • Hormuz & maritime: Iran selectively reopened Strait of Hormuz to allied states (Russia, India, China) while restricting others. Tactical impact: targeted commercial routing and insurance spikes expected.
  • Flight / infrastructure: Regional airspace disruption — airports closed in Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Jordan. Flight scans show multiple military aircraft transits.
  • International reactions: Russia (Medvedev) publicly condemns US strikes and frames actions as erosion of law; Russia conveyed condolences related to Iran leadership events. No major military deployments by European states in this window.
  • Domestic / social: Large funeral ceremonies in Iran for Khamenei reported; nationalist chants increase short-term risk of retaliatory operations.
  • Legal / criminal: Minor regional legal incidents (e.g., stabbing case in London) — no operational impact.
  • Intelligence note: Ceasefire signals fragile. Pauses have been temporary and quickly reversed. Expect tactical probing strikes and localized escalations.
  • 🟢 Good News: 10-day pause announced — diplomatic channel (Pakistan) active; limited reporting of local ceasefire arrangements.
Threat assessment: Escalating

Day 27 — Iran‑Israel / US campaign: Situation Report

  • Active strikes/sirens: US/Israeli airstrikes inside Iran continue. Iran, Hezbollah and Hamas launch missiles/rockets into Israel. Exchanges ongoing on multiple fronts.
  • Pause & diplomacy: Trump announced a SECOND 10‑day pause on Iranian energy strikes (deadline Apr 6, 2026 8 PM ET), citing an "Iranian Government request." Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan mediating. US delegation en route to Switzerland for discussions.
  • Airstrikes & counterstrikes: Earlier pause was violated when US/Israeli jets struck Isfahan and Khorramshahr. Israeli air operations and Iranian counter‑fire continue. Air defenses in Israel active.
  • Northern border (Hezbollah): Daily Hezbollah activity reported. Local ceasefire claims exist but shelling/rocket fire persists in parts of the border.
  • Strait of Hormuz / maritime: Iran allows passage for selected 'friendly' navies (Russia, India, China) while blocking others. Shipping routes remain politically restricted.
  • Airspace & infrastructure: Civil/military airspace highly restricted. Airports reported closed across Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon and Jordan.
  • International moves: Pakistan acting as mediator; Swiss venue for US‑Iran talks. Public condemnations from other capitals reported but no major troop deployments announced.
  • 🟢 Good News: A 10‑day pause was declared — window for diplomacy opened.
  • Threat assessment: Escalating.

  • תקיפות נגד ותגובה: ההפסקה הקודמת נפרצה — שוחתו מטרות באיספהאן וב‑Khorramshahr. המבצעים האוויריים הישראליים נמשכים; מערכות הגנה אוויריות פעילות בישראל.
  • גבול צפון (חיזבאללה): פעילות חיזבאללה יום־יומית. יש טענות להפסקת אש מקומית, אך ירי ופגיעות נמשכים בחלקים מהגבול.
  • מיצר הורמוז/ימי: איראן מאפשרת מעבר למדינות ידידותיות (רוסיה, הודו, סין) וחוסמת אחרות. מסלולי השיט מוגבלים פוליטית.
  • מרחב אווירי ותשתיות: מרחב אווירי אזרחי/צבאי מוגבל. נמלי תעופה דיווחו כנסגרים באיראן, ישראל, עיראק, סוריה, לבנון וירדן.
  • 🟢 חדשות טובות: הוכרזה הפסקה ל‑10 ימים — חלון דיפלומטי לפתיחה.
  • הערכת איום: מתדרדרת.
